column1: List of reported tornadoes - Monday, March 19, 2012
column4: A camper was flipped, a cinder block fence was toppled, and a barn and trailer were destroyed. One house in Gardendale suffered significant roof damage and was shifted off of its foundation, and several power poles were damaged. A horse trailer and a cotton trailer were tossed, and a travel trailer was destroyed. Large amounts of debris was scattered throughout the area, some of which was speared into the walls of adjacent structures. Three people were injured.
column5: A semi-trailer was overturned and a mobile home was destroyed. Multiple permanent homes had roofs torn off or sustained major structural damage. A metal storage shed was largely destroyed, and trees and power lines were downed. 14 homes were destroyed, 11 sustained major damage, and 7 others sustained minor damage.
column6: Power lines were knocked down and an RV was flipped.
column7: This strong tornado destroyed four frame homes and four mobile homes. Five other homes were severely damaged, and two others sustained minor damage. Four people were injured.
column9: A large machine shed was destroyed.
column11: Numerous trees and several structures were damaged along the path. Homes sustained roof damage, a metal shed was destroyed, and boat docks were lifted and thrown at Lake Francis.
column13: Brief tornado remained over open country, causing no damage.
column15: The roof of a mobile home was damaged, and numerous trees were snapped or uprooted.
column16: Several homes and a Walmart in town sustained damage, and a few trees and tree limbs were snapped.
